standard-dialogue.npc: What do you want? I'm a little busy here, so make it quick!

standard-dialogue.prompt: What would you like to say?

options.text: Can you sell me any food?

steps.player: Can you sell me any food?

steps.npc: I suppose I could sell you some cabbage, if you're willing to pay for it. Cabbage is good for you.

steps.text: If the player does not have at least 1 GP in their inventory:

steps.player: Oh, I haven't got any money.

steps.npc: Why are you asking me to sell you food if you haven't got any money? Go away!

steps.text: If the player has a full inventory:

steps.player: Oh, I haven't got enough space to carry it.

steps.npc: Why are you asking me to sell you food if you can't carry it? Go away!

steps.prompt: What would you like to say?

steps.text: 1 GP is deducted from inventory and and a cabbage gets placed.

steps.npc: It's a deal. Now, make sure you eat it all up. Cabbage is good for you.

options.text: No thanks, I don't like cabbage.

steps.player: No thanks, I don't like cabbage.

steps.npc: Bah! People these days only appreciate junk food.

options.text: Can you give me any free food?

steps.player: Can you give me any free food?

steps.npc: Can you give me any free money?

steps.player: Why should I give you free money?

steps.npc: Why should I give you free food?

options.text: I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.

steps.player: I don't want anything from this horrible kitchen.

steps.npc: How dare you? I put a lot of effort into cleaning this kitchen. My daily sweat and elbow-grease keep this kitchen clean!
